description: Type in the names, keep couples apart, and give everyone a private link that shows only who they drew. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

budget.description: The spending limit as people should read it, e.g. '€25' or 'around 200 kr'. Optional.

exchangeDate.description: The day presents are exchanged, as YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

exclusions.description: Pairs who must not draw each other, such as couples. Works both ways. Every name must be one of `people`. Refused if the rules leave no possible draw.

items.description: Two people who must not draw each other, e.g. ['Anna', 'Bo'].

locale.description: The language of the people's pages: one of en, de, es, fi, fr, it, nl, pl, pt. Anything else gives English.

note.description: A line shown to everybody, e.g. where and when you meet. Optional.

people.description: Everybody taking part, 3 or more. Names are compared case-insensitively, so the same name twice is refused — add an initial to tell two Annas apart. How many one draw may hold depends on the caller's plan; a group over it is refused with the number.

items.description: One person's name, as the others know them.

title.description: The group's name, shown at the top of everybody's page: 'Family Christmas 2026'. Up to 80 characters.

name: secret_santa
title: Secret Santa Generator
